assumptions.activeCapScenario: An optimistic capped-income bound, not a claim that every build can earn the cap daily.
assumptions.startingNodes: Root plus only the 12 legitimately available starter points, allocated through adjacent non-keystone nodes.
assumptions.nodeAllocation: Greedy connected physical-damage/life choices; only actual level budget; no jewels or free nodes.
assumptions.traits: One earned point per account level, bought through native buyTrait with actual limits, round-robin across 13 abilities.
assumptions.equipment: Highest owned rarity per slot, axe weapons only; no free upgrades. Leftover summon currency pays actual native weapon-upgrade cost.
assumptions.sockets: Starter active gems, only owned compatible supports; no trigger assumptions.
assumptions.goldTraining: Balanced actual attack/health levels via native trainingCost/trainHunt; no free gold or levels.
assumptions.benchmark: Stationary physical basic attacks with actual native crit, hit chance, tree effects and timing; no active-skill DPS, culling, AoE, leech, regeneration, healing, potions, avoidance or block credit. TTK is continuous expected DPS, not exact discrete hit latency. Rift expected single hit is shown separately.
assumptions.viableDefinition: Normal TTK <=2.5 s; boss TTK <=45 s and <= physical no-avoidance survival with one boss strike/1.8 s, accelerated by actual haste. This is a conservative build benchmark, not a measured run result.
assumptions.runRewards: Actual routed rooms only; seven fully cleared rooms give 252–504 XP by difficulty before the unchanged shared 720 XP daily cap. No reward for unvisited branches.
